content.text: Co-sleeping at 5 is really common, and kids this age usually do well with a small, predictable step. Tonight, tell Milo the plan during the day. Say something like "Soon you'll sleep in your own bed, and I'll sit with you while you fall asleep." Then do the same bedtime routine, and stay in his room until he's asleep, with you on a chair or on the floor beside his bed instead of in it. Keep that the same for a few nights before you change anything else.
